notes.status: STRUCTURE ONLY — no enemies or camps populated yet. Shape defined in SCHEMA.md §11.
notes.mirror: Enemies mirror PlayerCharacter: same Combatant base, same identity fields (name, race, gender, role, class). Class is derived from role via the same map as the player (SCHEMA.md §10).
notes.art: Because an enemy has class + race, it renders through D12's existing composition pipeline — body(class) + race overlay. No separate enemy art pipeline.
notes.behaviour: No energy. One telegraphed intent per turn, picked by weight from `intents` and constrained by `antiRepeat`. Multi-part turns are compound intents (one card doing several things), never two cards.
notes.branching: Nothing in resolution branches on an enemy's `class` or `role`. Behaviour comes entirely from `intents`. Class and role are visual and thematic.
notes.persistence: Enemies never return (D5). Enemy health is discarded at room end. Only the camp recurs — later nodes may hold different members of the same camp.

validation.everyIntentCardIsEnemySide: each intents[].cardId must resolve to a card in data/enemy-cards.json with side === 'enemy'
validation.classDerived: class must equal ROLE_TO_CLASS[role] from data/character-options.json
validation.raceIsKnown: race must be one of the ids in character-options.json races
validation.campIsKnown: camp must be one of the ids in this file's camps array

unset.camps: None defined. A camp is a faction of interviewers and is the only thing that recurs across the map.
unset.enemyRoles: Enemies currently draw from the same seven engineering roles as the player. Interviewer-specific roles — Recruiter, Hiring Manager, Founder — have no entry and no class mapping yet.
unset.health: No maxHealth values, for enemies or the player. Nothing in combat can be tuned until a health scale exists.
